title: Playing piano in spiritual churches and country jobs with Doc
summary: He plays in spiritual churches and goes on country jobs with a trumpet player called Doc who plays Dixieland and some rock and roll.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Sometimes I used to play the piano in the spiritual church, but then I'd just wait till they sing whatever they sing and pick it up, you see, and go on with them. You see, that's the way I'd do. Of course, they wouldn't have no music. They don't have no music, but I used to go around there when I was kind of, you know, before it got operated on, I used to go play in the churches, you know, and help them out because I haven't been playing much otherwise, but I'd get a job with this, this, now I play mostly with this fellow. He always come get me to play with him going out in the country, you know. They call him Doc. Doc?

What does he play? No, I don't know. Trumpet, trumpet. He played trumpet. What do you think? He hires his own men. He hires different men all the time to play, but he's a trumpet player. He been playing trumpet quite a while. He plays this Dixieland. And he tries to rock and roll too. He didn't sing, you know. But I've been playing with him off and on.
